welcomeBody: Let's get your account set up — it only takes a couple of minutes.
profileHint: Add a photo and a few details so colleagues recognize you.
profileAvatarHint: Click the avatar to upload a photo.
departmentHint: Which team or department are you part of?

tourCta: Want a quick tour of the app too?
restartOnboardingHint: Redo the setup wizard for your profile and preferences.
